audit.why: Neither champion ever fully owns the lane; K'Sante takes the mid levels, everything else is close.
audit.corrected: diff kept; phase text rewritten so the two K'Sante rows have a stated cause.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ornn rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 and never showed K'Sante's mid-lane window.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Skill, Skill, Skill. The page's own whys[2] opens 'K'Sante owns this' while win[2] said Ornn — the two layers disagreed with each other and with the data.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 5 and 6 flipped to Skill and rows 2 and 3 to K'Sante, in matched full/content pairs; ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ntofo Strikes is described as a knock-up, Path Maker is called a 'block', and no cooldown appears anywhere.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes is 3.5s at 450 range and at two stacks fires a shockwave that PULLS — it never knocks up. Path Maker is a 14s charge during which he takes reduced damage, releasing as a knock-back and stun, so damage spent into the charge is wasted. Footwork is a 10s dash plus shield. All Out is 120s at rank 1, knocks you through a wall and then dashes after you, healing at the cost of defences.
audit.corrected: Names, the 3.5s / 14s / 10s / 120s numbers, the pull-not-knock-up correction and the charge-eats-damage interaction written into the phases, trades, cooldowns and wants.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was named in Itemization but tied to nothing.
audit.why: All Out grants healing, so a grind without Grievous Wounds loses; and Path Maker's damage does not respect stacked resistances, so raw armour is the wrong single answer.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.mid.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when K'Sante's All Out is down.
edits.after: Ntofo Strikes is 3.5s but only 450 range and two stacks pull — neither of you can commit yet, so farm.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so K'Sante must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Path Maker takes reduced damage while it charges and stuns on release — he eats your E-Q setup and answers it. Concede the level.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around All Out's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: With Path Maker on 14s and Footwork's shield on 10s he has two ways out of your E-Q — bait one out before you spend anything.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — K'Sante's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God's double knock-up wins the all-in — but All Out is 120s and knocks you back through a wall. Whoever ults second wins.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on All Out's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet lands, his fighter items keep pace — an even stage decided by who commits first.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. K'Sante carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He wins the isolated 1v1 and you win the fight with a team around you — stop side-laning alone and group for the CC chain.

edits.before: He can start chaining Q knock-up procs, but with no W block point yet he can't punish hard — neither of you commits.
edits.after: He can start chaining Ntofo Strikes for the two-stack pull, but with no Path Maker yet he cannot punish it — nobody commits.

edits.before: He out-scales: R strips his resists into percent-HP isolation that ignores your armor, so play teamfights, not the 1v1.
edits.after: All Out trades his resistances for damage and isolates you, so he wins the 1v1 — but you win the 5v5. Pick the ground.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind K'Sante, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Q the pillar behind K'Sante, E into it for the knockup, then W-Brittle — do it after Path Maker's 14s charge, never into it.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: E into his Path Maker charge — he takes reduced damage through it and stuns you on the release.

edits.before: His duelist mode. Trade when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 120s at rank 1: it knocks you through a wall, then he dashes after.

edits.before: That is K'Sante's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Ntofo Strikes stacks fire a shockwave that pulls you in — break the stack.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: All Out heals him — Grievous Wounds before you grind him down.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Path Maker takes reduced damage while charging — every point of damage you spend into it is wasted.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Trade when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — 120s at rank 1; it knocks you through a wall and he follows. - Path Maker: 14s, reduced damage while charging. - Ntofo Strikes: 3.5s, two stacks pull you in.

edits.before: Trade strictly around All Out: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade after Path Maker's 14s, not into it. Two Ntofo Strikes stacks pull you — break the chain and never grind him without anti-heal.

edits.before: Block your W and E with his W (Ntofo Strikes / dash block) and dash through your telegraphed E-Q
edits.after: Absorb your W and E inside Path Maker's charge, then Footwork-dash out of your telegraphed E-Q

edits.before: Poke you with Q knock-up procs while you are mana-starved early and shove the wave
edits.after: Chain Ntofo Strikes for the two-stack pull while you are mana-starved, and shove the wave

notes: Two suspect names the checker flagged, 'Searing Charge' and 'All Out', are both correct — no action. The real defect was slot mislabelling, and per the mirror two full-layer fields still carry it (dosFull[1].t and the wrong-slot phrasing in dosFull[2].t 'Dodge his Q knockups', which is now doubly wrong since Ntofo Strikes pulls rather than knocking up — it needs a rewrite the length band did not allow me here). I also did not restate the page's 'unstoppable / shield' claim for Bellows Breath, which Riot's text does not support.
